text.hi: अपनी किताब के पेज 16 पर ‘My Childhood’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab ke page 16 par ‘My Childhood’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘My Childhood’ on page 16 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: What was the task that Mr. Giles set?

questionMeaning.hi: मिस्टर जाइल्स ने क्या काम दिया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Mister Giles ne kya kaam diya?

options: He gave five words to write as a spelling exercise.
He asked them to draw a picture.
He asked them to sing a song.
steps.answer: He gave five words to write as a spelling exercise.
steps.modelAnswer: Mr. Giles gave the students five words to write as a spelling exercise.

modelMeaning.hi: मिस्टर जाइल्स ने बच्चों को स्पेलिंग के अभ्यास के लिए पाँच शब्द लिखने को दिए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mister Giles ne bachchon ko spelling ke abhyaas ke liye paanch shabd likhne ko diye.

steps.question: Why didn't Gandhiji copy?

questionMeaning.hi: गांधीजी ने नक़ल क्यों नहीं की?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Gandhiji ne nakal kyon nahi ki?

options: He was honest and did not want to cheat.
He did not see his neighbour.
steps.answer: He was honest and did not want to cheat.
steps.modelAnswer: Gandhiji did not copy because he was honest. He did not want to cheat, even when the teacher tried to prompt him.

modelMeaning.hi: गांधीजी ने नक़ल नहीं की क्योंकि वे ईमानदार थे। टीचर के इशारे के बाद भी वे धोखा नहीं देना चाहते थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Gandhiji ne nakal nahi ki kyonki woh imaandaar the. Teacher ke ishaare ke baad bhi woh dhokha nahi dena chahte the.

steps.question: What left a lasting impression on Gandhiji's mind?

questionMeaning.hi: गांधीजी के मन पर गहरी छाप किसने छोड़ी?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Gandhiji ke man par gehri chhaap kisne chhodi?

options: the book about Shravana and his picture carrying his blind parents
steps.answer: the book about Shravana and his picture carrying his blind parents
steps.modelAnswer: The book ‘Shravana Pitrabhakti Natak’ and the picture of Shravana carrying his blind parents left a lasting impression on his mind.

modelMeaning.hi: ‘श्रवण पितृभक्ति नाटक’ किताब और अंधे माता-पिता को काँवड़ में ले जाते श्रवण की तस्वीर ने उनके मन पर गहरी छाप छोड़ी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: ‘Shravan Pitrabhakti Naatak’ kitaab aur andhe maata-pita ko kaanwad mein le jaate Shravan ki tasveer ne unke man par gehri chhaap chhodi.

steps.question: Why were ‘Shravana’ and ‘Harishchandra’ important to Mahatma Gandhi?

questionMeaning.hi: श्रवण और हरिश्चंद्र गांधीजी के लिए क्यों ज़रूरी थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Shravan aur Harishchandra Gandhiji ke liye kyon zaroori the?

options: They taught him love for parents and truthfulness.
steps.answer: They taught him love for parents and truthfulness.
steps.modelAnswer: Shravana taught him love and service for parents, and Harishchandra taught him to always speak the truth. They were living realities for him.

modelMeaning.hi: श्रवण ने उन्हें माता-पिता की सेवा और हरिश्चंद्र ने हमेशा सच बोलना सिखाया। वे उनके लिए जीवित सच्चाई थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Shravan ne unhe maata-pita ki seva aur Harishchandra ne hamesha sach bolna sikhaaya. Woh unke liye jeevit sachchaai the.

steps.question: Are they important to you and why?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या वे तुम्हारे लिए ज़रूरी हैं, और क्यों?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya woh tumhare liye zaroori hain, aur kyon?

options: Yes, they teach us to be truthful and to love our parents.
No, they are only old stories.
steps.answer: Yes, they teach us to be truthful and to love our parents.
steps.modelAnswer: Yes, they are important to me because they teach me to always tell the truth and to love and serve my parents.

modelMeaning.hi: हाँ, वे मेरे लिए ज़रूरी हैं क्योंकि वे सिखाते हैं कि हमेशा सच बोलो और माता-पिता की सेवा करो।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Haan, woh mere liye zaroori hain kyonki woh sikhaate hain ki hamesha sach bolo aur maata-pita ki seva karo.

steps.question: True or false? Gandhiji copied the spelling from his neighbour.

questionMeaning.hi: गांधीजी ने पड़ोसी से स्पेलिंग नक़ल की।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Gandhiji ne padosi se spelling nakal ki.
